definitions.gloss: patterned item; item with a printed design
definitions.explanation: Clothing, fabric, or other items that have a pattern or design on them, as opposed to solid colors. Commonly used in fashion and textile contexts.

examples.japanese: {柄物|がらもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
{柄物|がらもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧だ。
examples.english: Combining patterned and solid-color items looks stylish.

examples.japanese: {柄物|がらもの}どうし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{上手|うま}くいく→上手くいく：21787_umakuiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Pairing patterned items together is difficult, but when done well it looks unique.

notes:
⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ means 'pattern' or 'design,' and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ means 'thing' or 'item.' {柄物|がらもの} is used in fashion and shopping to describe anything with a printed pattern — stripes, florals, checks, etc. It contrasts with ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ (solid color, plain).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柄物|がらもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧ (patterned skirt)
- {柄物|がらもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ (patterned and plain)
- {柄物|がらもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear something patterned)
- ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な{柄物|がらもの} (a boldly patterned item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ — solid color, plain (the opposite of {柄物|がらもの})
- ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ — pattern, design (the pattern itself, not the item)
- ⟦プリント→プリント：01539_purinto⟧ — print (loanword; often used for specific printed designs on clothing)
